messages:
incident-bot: PAGER 2812346789 -> Dedicated pool alert: tenant=helixbank, cluster=vpc-dedicated-us-east-2, gpu_util=99%, inflight_queue=146, error_rate+latency spike. Auto-burst disabled by tenant flag. Paging oncall
alice: oncall ack. I'm up. Which region?
raj: us-east-2, I can see the pool saturated. Shard A has all 12 reserved cards pinned to helixbank. Background batch started at 03:12 UTC and didn't finish.
tessa: looking at autoscaler config: tenant_burst_allowed=false per contract. No auto-burst trigger will fire.
ops-bot: Recent deploys: none in last 12h. KV cache thrash detected, tail latency rising. link: https://grafana/redwood/boards/helixbank-pool
billing-bot: contract note: HelixBank enterprise private deployment - burst disabled unless eval + legal sign-off.
alice: immediate triage options (fast -> slow):
  1) migrate non-critical batch jobs out to shared-hosted (low risk)
  2) apply tenant-level concurrency cap to shed realtime traffic gracefully
  3) request emergency manual burst (requires account approval)
  4) spin up spare reserved nodes from infra ops (manual, 5-10m)
raj: I'll migrate batch jobs now. They are labeled job-type=batch in helixbank-ns.
raj: commands I'm running:
```
kubectl -n helixbank get pods -l job=batch -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl patch -p '{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"pool":"shared-surge"}}}'
```
raj: started migrating ~70 batch pods -> ETA ~7m. queue down 30%
alice: pinging account team for HelixBank consent to enable 30-60m emergency burst. George, can you reach out?
george: pinged HelixBank SRE (helix-sre@helixbank.com). They are online and prefer we enable burst for 45 minutes then reassess. Legal wants a note in the ticket.
helix-sre: replying here: yes, enable emergency burst 45m. we'll monitor and revert if issues.
tessa: while burst approval coming, put an immediate soft cap on concurrent realtime calls to reduce tail latency. Proposed: tenant.max_concurrency=10 for helixbank routes.
raj: applying concurrency cap now:
```
redwood-cli routes update --tenant helixbank --set max_concurrency=10
```
raj: change propagated. realtime queue decreased, 95p latency improving from 2.2s -> 1.1s
ops-bot: batch migration finished. inflight_queue -> 42, gpu_util -> 74%
alice: since customer approved, request manual burst. Tessa, can infra provision 3 ephemeral GPUs from reserved pool and attach to helixbank pool?
tessa: requesting manual burst via infra runbook. Provisioning ID: prov-2812-eburst. Expected node-ready ~4m. Note: these are ephemeral and billed to customer under emergency usage policy.
ops-bot: nodes up in 3m. attaching to pool...
ops-bot: burst complete: +3 GPUs attached, pool capacity increased, gpu_util -> 61%, queue -> 12, tail latency 95p -> 0.55s
alice: good. customer notified and monitoring. logging action items: 1) revoke burst after 45m 2) run postmortem / contract review to allow configurable auto-burst or add burst add-on 3) tune queue alert thresholds to trigger earlier (e.g., queue > 30 for 10m)
raj: leaving follow-ups in INC-2812346789: include timeline, commands run, customer consent screenshot, billing note.
alice: handoff: I'm pausing after this stabilization window. Raj will monitor next 60m and escalate if queue grows. Raj, confirm you have escalation path to infra oncall.
raj: confirmed. I'll watch for any re-spike and will revert concurrency cap when stable.
george: I'll coordinate billing/legal follow-ups with HelixBank and update the account ticket.
helix-sre: thanks team. appreciate the quick migration and burst. please share metrics and latency graphs when available.
alice: final status update for thread: mitigations applied (batch migration, concurrency cap, emergency burst), customer-approved burst for 45m, pool stabilized. No other tenants affected. Impact: P2 customer-visible degraded performance for HelixBank for ~36m before stabilization. Reopening if regressions. :white_check_mark:
